# README Writer Checklist

- Inspect existing README, docs, build files, CI, Docker/Compose, config, migrations, scripts, and API docs.
- Preserve accurate useful content.
- Remove stale copied project/company/package/internal URL references.
- Document only commands supported by repo evidence.
- Use placeholders for unknown values.
- Do not include secret-shaped sample values.
- Document required config, profiles, ports, migrations, tests, and troubleshooting only when supported by files.
- Keep sections task-oriented for developers.
- Verify commands and links when practical.
- State skipped checks honestly.
